apps.name: MES Radio
apps.description: Push-to-talk for your MES team. Talk on radio channels and replay received voice.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Radio 1.0.7

Live speech gets progressively quieter when the speaker is estimated to be within 5 meters. At 5 meters or beyond, it uses your saved Quiet, Medium or Loud level. Live speech is reduced, not fully muted.
Recordings keep their original audio, and Replay plays at your saved listening level regardless of how close the speaker was.
Works for regular channels and Broadcast. A nearby-speaker status explains when live volume is lowered.

Both phones must enable location sharing and have fresh positions reporting accuracy of 5 meters or better. Missing, old or imprecise positions leave live volume unchanged. Location remains an estimate, and sharing stops when the app leaves the foreground; this does not guarantee feedback prevention. Two-phone proximity and acoustic testing remain pending.

Keeps the Broadcast speaker toggle, speech-reactive glow, radar stabilization and connection recovery from previous releases.
Android 9 or newer. Updates MES Radio in place and preserves sign-in, settings and voice history. Do not uninstall before updating.

apps.name: MES Run Beta
apps.description: Run production, coordinate MES staff, and follow line progress using the production MES service.
apps.releaseNotes:
SIGNING KEY REPLACED: this release cannot update the old installation. Uninstall the old app first, which deletes its local settings, drafts and recordings, then install this version and sign in again. The package ID is unchanged. Server-side records are not deleted by uninstalling.

MES Run Beta 25

Redesigned stop form with gray reason codes, searchable reasons and separate notes.
Add camera or gallery photos to unplanned stops. Confirm uploads photos first, with circular percentage progress on each thumbnail, then saves the stop. Failed uploads can be retried.
Photos are stored as WebP in Dropbox and linked to the stop in production history.
Uses the production MES service. Sign in with your existing authorized supervisor PIN.

Rebuilt from the latest pulled source with the replacement signing identity on September 23, 2026.

apps.name: MES Store
apps.description: Browse and install approved MES apps, read guides, and keep your apps up to date.
apps.releaseNotes:
MES Store 1.2.24

Migrates release approval to the replacement signing authority and a separate catalog for updated stores. APK identity, signature, checksum, and release-approval verification remain required.

Install this APK directly over the existing MES Store. Do not uninstall. The Android signing certificate and package ID are unchanged, so settings and app data are preserved.

This is a one-time manual update: older stores trust the unavailable original approval key and cannot authorize this migration through their built-in updater. Their original catalog remains available. After installing 1.2.24, subsequent approved updates use the replacement authority.

Requires Android 9 or newer.

apps.name: Upkeep Beta
apps.description: Practice maintenance tasks, preventive maintenance, inspections, and purchase approvals with device-only sample data.
apps.releaseNotes:
Upkeep 0.1.0-beta.1 — procedure-testing beta

Native Android app with charcoal surfaces, orange actions and animated transitions.
Bottom navigation: Tasks, Report, PM, Inspection, History.

Report problems with location, priority, schedule, deadline and generated demo photos.
Technicians pick up tasks, track active work, pause, hold with a reason, resolve and close repairs. Issuers can cancel with a reason.
Technicians enter part names, quantities, prices and purchase links. Approvers approve, request changes or reject. Test ordering and receiving without making a real purchase.
PM includes recurring service plans, overdue tracking and required checklists. Closing a service schedules its next occurrence.
Inspections record Pass, Fail or N/A; failed findings require notes and create follow-up repair tickets.
History includes repair notes, activity, photos, PM and inspection records.

MOCK DATA ONLY: no server connection, login credentials, database writes, real orders or photo uploads. Changes are held only in memory and reset when the app process restarts. Android configuration changes preserve the current session.
Tap the beta strip to switch Technician / Issuer / Approver, open Purchases & approvals, or reset sample data. Purchase links are previewed in-app only. This beta tests procedures on a single device; there is no multi-user synchronization.
